acceptanceCriteria.text: Ordinary, release, and `epic/<issue-number>-<slug>` PRs use canonical organization governance semantics.
Mottainai no longer independently defines organization-level branch-name or PR-title semantics.
Mottainai-specific validation remains enforced as separate product checks/jobs.
Relevant governance and product-specific tests pass.
An Epic branch such as `epic/890-runtime-certification` is accepted through the canonical governance path.

issue.title: refactor(governance): consume canonical organization PR governance
